column2: Minecraft server runs on k3s, is reachable on 25565/tcp, and configuration is delivered via ConfigMap/Secret.
column6: Server runs on k3s and is reachable; configuration uses ConfigMap/Secret appropriately; image is pinned to a specific ECR tag.
column9: Server runs and is reachable; ConfigMap/Secret usage is mostly correct with minor issues.
column12: Server partially works on k3s but has significant configuration or reachability issues.
column15: Minecraft does not run on k3s, or server is not reachable.

column2: World data persists across pod restarts; S3 backups are implemented; restore process is documented and proven.
column6: World data survives pod deletion/restart (shown in video); S3 backup and restore are both demonstrated; storage strategy is clearly documented.
column9: Persistence works and is demonstrated; S3 backup/restore is functional but evidence has minor gaps.
column12: Some persistence mechanism exists but is unreliable, or S3 backup/restore is incomplete.
column15: World data does not persist, or no backup/restore process is demonstrated.

column2: Liveness and readiness probes are defined and justified; resource requests/limits are set; rollout and rollback are demonstrated.
column6: Probes are defined with clear justification; resource settings are present and reasonable; both rollout and rollback are demonstrated successfully in video.
column9: Probes and resource settings are present; rollout/rollback works but one area has weaker justification or evidence.
column12: Some operational controls exist but probes, resources, or rollout/rollback are missing or incomplete.
column15: No probes, resource controls, or rollout/rollback demonstrated.

column2: A realistic failure scenario is executed with clear detection, recovery steps, and documented outcome.
column6: Failure is realistic and clearly introduced; detection method is shown; recovery is executed and verified; outcome is documented with lessons learned.
column9: Failure drill is executed but detection or recovery evidence has minor gaps.
column12: Drill is attempted but the scenario is trivial, or detection/recovery is unclear.
column15: No failure drill demonstrated or documented.

column2: Architecture diagram, tradeoff explanations, and runbook updates are clear and usable by another operator.
column6: Architecture diagram is accurate; tradeoffs are explained concisely; runbooks cover deployment, rollout/rollback, and backup/restore; all are usable by a new operator.
column9: Documentation is mostly complete; minor gaps in one area.
column12: Documentation is partial; multiple sections are missing or vague.
column15: Documentation is largely missing or not usable.
